source_text:
Title: Greek Chicken Gyros with Protein Tzatziki
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 500 g | chicken breast |  | 000044
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 30 ml | olive oil |  | 000378
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 20 g | lemon |  | 000130
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 2 tsp | dried oregano |  | 000257
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 1 tsp | ground cumin |  | 000278
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 1 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 0.5 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 1 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Greek Marinated Chicken | 0.5 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Homemade Tzatziki | 250 ml | Protein Yoghurt |  | 000641
- Homemade Tzatziki | 0.5 pcs | Cucumber |  | 000642
- Homemade Tzatziki | 5 g | garlic |  | 000112
- Homemade Tzatziki | 10 g | lemon |  | 000130
- Homemade Tzatziki | 1 tsp | dried dill |  | 000261
- Homemade Tzatziki | 0.25 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Assembly and Garnish | 4 pcs | pita |  | 000340
- Assembly and Garnish | 150 g | tomatoes |  | 000093
- Assembly and Garnish | 50 g | onion |  | 000111
- Assembly and Garnish | 100 g | lettuce |  | 000079

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Greek Marinated Chicken | Prep |  | SAFETY: Wash your hands and clean the cutting board before handling raw chicken breast.
2. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Grate the cucumber using the large holes of a box grater.
3. Assembly and Garnish | Prep |  | Thinly slice the onion, dice the tomatoes, and shred the lettuce into fine ribbons.
4. Greek Marinated Chicken | Prep |  | Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized strips or 2cm cubes for even cooking.
5. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Place the grated cucumber in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze firmly to remove as much moisture as possible.
6. Assembly and Garnish | Cook |  | Lightly brush the pita breads with a drop of olive oil and toast them in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute per side until soft and warm.
7. Greek Marinated Chicken | Prep |  | In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, dried oregano, ground cumin, garlic powder, ground onion, salt, and black pepper.
8. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Finely mince the garlic cloves until they form a paste-like consistency.
9. Assembly and Garnish | Serve |  | Lay a warm pita flat and spread a generous tablespoon of tzatziki sauce down the center.
10. Greek Marinated Chicken | Prep |  | Add the chicken to the bowl, toss well to coat, cover, and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
11. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | In a medium bowl, combine the Protein Yoghurt, drained cucumber, and minced garlic.
12. Assembly and Garnish | Serve |  | Place a handful of shredded lettuce on top of the sauce, followed by a portion of the cooked Greek chicken.
13. Greek Marinated Chicken | Cook |  | Heat a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat until it begins to smoke slightly.
14. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Stir in the lemon juice, dried dill, and salt until the mixture is uniform.
15. Assembly and Garnish | Serve |  | Top with sliced onions and diced tomatoes.
16. Greek Marinated Chicken | Cook |  | Add the chicken strips to the hot pan and sear for 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 74°C.
17. Homemade Tzatziki | Serve |  | Cover and refrigerate the tzatziki until ready to assemble the gyros to allow flavors to meld.
18. Assembly and Garnish | Serve |  | Fold the pita over the filling, wrap the bottom tightly with parchment paper or foil, and serve immediately.
19. Greek Marinated Chicken | Serve |  | Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest on a clean plate for 3 minutes before serving.
